# Local barcode fallback

These unmodified distribution files are loaded only when the browser does not
provide the native `BarcodeDetector` API.

- `zbar-wasm.js` and `zbar.wasm`: `@undecaf/zbar-wasm` 0.9.16 (LGPL-2.1+)
- `barcode-detector-polyfill.js`: `@undecaf/barcode-detector-polyfill` 0.9.23 (MIT)

Upstream repositories:

- https://github.com/undecaf/zbar-wasm
- https://github.com/undecaf/barcode-detector-polyfill

The corresponding license texts are included in this directory.
